candidates.title: Candidates
candidates.subtitle: Evaluate and manage your candidate applications
candidates.scoringGuideDescription: Each candidate receives a score from 0 to 100 based on multiple verified factors. This score translates into a risk level (A–D) to facilitate your decision.
candidates.scoreCategoryEmploymentDesc: Contract type, seniority, industry, and position. A permanent contract with more than 2 years weighs significantly.
candidates.scoreCategoryFinancialDesc: Income-to-rent ratio, monthly obligations, and additional income. Ideally rent does not exceed 30% of income.
candidates.scoreCategoryCreditDesc: Credit bureau reports, outstanding debts, and payment habits. No negative reports earns points.
candidates.scoreCategoryRentalDesc: References from previous landlords, time at previous residences, and reasons for moving.
candidates.scoreCategoryProfileDesc: Complete documentation, data consistency, and identity verification.
candidates.riskExcellentDesc: Very reliable profile. Stable income, excellent credit history, solid employment. Minimal risk of non-payment.
candidates.riskGoodDesc: Solid profile with strong fundamentals. May have a minor factor to consider, but risk is low.
candidates.riskFairDesc: Profile with mixed factors. It is recommended to request additional guarantees such as a co-signer or larger deposit.
candidates.riskPoorDesc: Profile with significant risk factors. Caution and special conditions are recommended if approval is decided.
candidates.scoringNote: The scoring is a support tool, not an automatic decision. Always review the candidate's full profile before approving or rejecting.
